models_evaluated: multi-label chest X-ray deep learning classifier (CheXpert)

links.outcome: Quality-control F1 under input-image noise levels 0.001-0.005 versus baseline
links.effect: Averaged across noise levels, under IxG-based evaluation, retrieval-based variant improved bootstrapped F1 by 21.92% and non-retrieval variant by 13.53% over baseline.
links.quote: Averaged across input-image noise levels of 0.001-0.005, under IxG-based evaluation, the proposed framework showed improvements in bootstrapped F1 over the baseline, with the retrieval-based variant achieving a 21.92% improvement and the corresponding non-retrieval variant achieving a 13.53% improvement.

Retrieval-based case-based explanations for flagged predictions

screen.practice: quality control flagging of unreliable predictions with case-based explanations
screen.reason: Evaluates a quality control and failure detection framework (INFORMER) that monitors predictions using gradient saliency and provides case-based explanations to clinicians.
